summary: Isometric flow diagram with one station per real process step, joined by pipes. Small packets (documents, tickets or data rows) travel the pipes: grey on the way in, brand colour once processed, with a tick after the checking step, and they leave on the right. The lit station moves along the line; hovering a step below lights its station. Station heights, pipe height and packet speed are seeded from the brand name. Needs 3-6 real steps from the brief (title, one sentence, icon, packet type); the step whose icon is shield-check, clipboard-check, check-circle, check, search or eye marks the checking step, otherwise the last step does. Fits document, claims, invoice and data processing.
